item.blurb: IKKB Raises $3M Seed. IKKB raises $3M in a seed round led by Canary to secure regulatory licenses and expand its multi-currency global account platform for businesses.
NJD Games Raises $1.1M Seed. NJD Games raises $1.1 million in a seed round led by Impact46 and Merak Capital to expand its gaming portfolio and integrate AI technology.
Nextesy Raises $10.4M Seed. Nextesy raises $10.4 million in a seed round led by Swisscom Ventures to expand its AI business software and operations internationally.
Vegapay Raises $10M Series A. Vegapay raises $10M Series A round co-led by Vertex Ventures and Prosus to expand its credit infrastructure platform for banks and financial institutions.
AirEdge Raises $15M Series A. AirEdge raises $15 million in Series A funding to expand its cloud-native product lifecycle and quality management software for industrial manufacturers.
PCO Raises $1.3M Pre-Series A. Busan-based AI video optimization startup PCO raises $1.3M in a pre-Series A round led by Sunbo Angel Partners to expand its global market reach.
SatSure Raises $21M Series B. SatSure raises $21M in Series B funding led by Antariksh Venture Capital Fund to scale its Earth intelligence AI platform and international operations.
GrabrFi Raises $6M in Funding. GrabrFi raises $6M in funding led by Bling Capital to expand its cross-border financial platform for global businesses and freelancers.
